facts.fact: ANADEN and Comores Cables officially launched the public administration's data centre on 19 May 2025, which the promoters frame as a step for digital sovereignty.
The Comoros ministry's 2026 Technopole project note sets an objective to equip the country with a data center and a national cloud, with a sovereign cloud among its infrastructure components.
